apps.localizedDescription:
### Added

- **iOS**: eight sound-effect presets and a ten-band custom equalizer on the now-playing page and in Settings, with a live response curve. A change applies to the playing track without rebuilding the player (#191).

### Improved

- **iOS**: the app follows the system language, English or Simplified Chinese, as the macOS app does (#191).
- **Localization**: the English interface is complete on macOS, iOS and CarPlay. Album, playlist, artist and search pages, the iOS updater and CarPlay no longer fall back to Chinese, and VoiceOver reads the now-playing buttons in English. CarPlay play counts use K/M/B in English.
- **Downloads**: a failed download now says why — the service's own reason (such as a risk-control refusal) or the system error code — instead of only asking you to check the network (#141).

---

### 新增

- **iOS**：播放页和设置里新增八种音效预设和十段自定义均衡器，并带实时频率响应曲线。切换后直接作用于当前播放，不用重建播放器（#191）。

### 改进

- **iOS**：与 macOS 一样跟随系统语言，支持英文和简体中文（#191）。
- **本地化**：macOS、iOS 与 CarPlay 的英文界面补齐。专辑、歌单、歌手与搜索页面、iOS 更新流程和 CarPlay 不再夹杂中文，播放页按钮的 VoiceOver 朗读也有了英文。CarPlay 的播放次数在英文下使用 K/M/B。
- **下载**：下载失败时会说明原因（如服务端的风控拒绝）或系统错误码，而不再只提示检查网络（#141）。

## English

This MeloX iOS + Apple Watch release was built automatically by GitHub Actions.

### MeloX Website

Visit the [MeloX website](https://melox.luoxe.cn/) for project information and the latest news.

### Download

- `MeloX-iOS-unsigned.ipa`: unsigned iOS package containing the Apple Watch app

### Installation

The IPA is unsigned and must be signed before installation.

### Build Information

- Version: `v1.4.1`
- Commit: `09713edb847a0f0a3515a34f779cc630d4fe5985`
- Build: `148`

## 简体中文

这是由 GitHub Actions 自动构建的 MeloX iOS + Apple Watch 发行版本。

### MeloX 官网

访问 [MeloX 官网](https://melox.luoxe.cn/) 了解项目与最新动态。

### 下载说明

- `MeloX-iOS-unsigned.ipa`：包含 Apple Watch App 的 iOS 未签名安装包

### 安装说明

该 IPA 未签名，需要自行签名后安装。

### 版本信息

- 版本：`v1.4.1`
- Commit：`09713edb847a0f0a3515a34f779cc630d4fe5985`
- 构建编号：`148`

## What's New / 更新内容

## 简体中文

- 首页每日推荐等快捷入口默认使用更小的紧凑卡片，可在通用设置中切换大小
- 新增首页推荐、音乐库和歌单信息自动缓存，再次打开时优先显示已有内容，网络刷新失败时保留缓存
- 修复了播放队列中播放模式控件吸顶切换时，歌曲列表和滚动指示条位置跳动的问题（感谢 @Fab1e2000）

## English

- Home shortcuts, including Daily Recommendations, now use smaller cards by default, with a compact layout toggle in General settings
- Added automatic caching for home recommendations, library lists, and playlist details, with cached content shown first and preserved when network refreshes fail
- Fixed jumps in the song list and scroll indicator when playback mode controls pin or unpin at the top of the queue (thanks to @Fab1e2000)

apps.localizedDescription:
### New Features

- **artist**: Give Mornye's album card Music's plus and note
- **search**: Drop Mornye desktop's filter chips, as in Music
- **artist**: Shuffle an artist's Library songs from the Mornye hero
- **mornye**: Music's glass inspector, player actions and Home text
- **home**: Make Mornye's Home Music's own, picks included
- **home**: Recently Played and extension playlists for Mornye
- **theme**: Move a stored red Mornye accent to blue once
- **search**: Mornye Top Results and a compact desktop toolbar
- **home**: Open Mornye Home with Top Picks banners
- **mornye**: Pour menus, fold the bar into one glass, desktop artist row
- **desktop**: Bring Mornye's chrome and motion closer to Music
- **track**: Copy a track's streaming service link
- **library**: Play, queue and delete files from a collection selection
- **library**: Find downloads that were moved to the download folder (#809)
- **desktop**: Use the expressive transport in the Material player bar
- **player**: Make automatic fullscreen lyrics optional
- **network**: Prefetch upcoming NAS songs to a local cache
- **library**: Upload local songs to network storage
- **desktop**: Add application tab back and forward history
- **cast**: Google Cast on iOS and desktop
- **cast**: Add a Rust Google Cast sender and media server
- **lyrics**: Edit and sync lyrics from the player
- **player**: Open audio files and folders directly
- **home**: Lay out the Material desktop Home for a wide pane
- **library**: Save network songs offline with independent copies
- **files**: Safely reorganize existing library files (#781)
- Implement plain Windows path handling and matching for file operations by [@kevenchantre](https://github.com/kevenchantre)
- Enhance library reorganization and file handling by [@kevenchantre](https://github.com/kevenchantre)
- **files**: Apply folder and filename rules to existing downloads by [@kevenchantre](https://github.com/kevenchantre)
- **player**: Slide artwork with track swipes (#788)
- **player**: Slide artwork with track swipe by [@frpboy](https://github.com/frpboy)
- **library**: Add whole-library metadata re-enrichment (#787) ([#787](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/pull/787))
- Add re-enrich all tracks functionality and related UI components by [@kevenchantre](https://github.com/kevenchantre)
- **lyrics**: Add fast and synced translation modes
- **android**: Add Google Cast audio output
- **library**: Add search by saved lyrics
- **lastfm**: Add desktop account connection and scrobbling
- **lyrics**: Automatically embed online search results
- **lyrics**: Sync AI romanization to original word timing
- **lyrics**: Sync translated phrases to original word timing
- **network**: Edit metadata and lyrics on SMB and WebDAV
- **desktop**: Dismiss paused playback from the player bar

### Bug Fixes

- **android**: Register player events before create replies
- **android**: Move player operations off the UI thread
- **metadata**: Re-enrich writable network library files
- **player**: Dismiss search focus when opening now playing
- **player**: Keep landscape motion covers square and toggle lyric controls
- **audio**: Clarify Bluetooth codec access and bitrate display
- **metadata**: Grant file access for Windows artwork paths
- **artist**: Isolate album notes and clarify download actions
- **search**: Preserve all extension filters on desktop
- **home**: Respect feed selection and provider-neutral layouts
- **audio**: Distinguish exclusive output from bit-perfect playback
- **home**: Hold Mornye's card until Recently Played loads
- **home**: Let Top Picks read any extension
- **artist**: Let Mornye's artist page fall away to near black
- **home**: Size Mornye's Home shelves as Music's pane does
- **mixes**: Build again when the cache is empty at the same total
- **home**: Keep Mornye's Home neutral and enlarge its toolbar glass
- **artist**: Size the Mornye desktop toolbar as in Music and drop its title
- **player**: Keep Mornye's layout still when a computer takes over
- **windows**: Build without the ATL component and find Inno Setup (#764)
- **orientation**: Let tablets rotate outside the full player (#807)
- **playback**: Remove missing files from the active queue
- **windows**: Update WASAPI backend and use driver minimum buffer
- **playback**: Skip missing local tracks
- **playback**: Release local audio before deletion
- **nas**: Accept format hints in metadata proxy URLs
- **ios**: Play formats AVPlayer cannot open and skip unplayable songs
- **windows**: Poll connectivity without registering network listeners
- **lint**: Align Library test overrides and notifier APIs
- **android**: Keep media controls responsive during artwork reads
- **desktop**: Keep Escape on the page and record every destination
- **lyrics**: Translate straight into the saved language
- **link**: Refresh phone catalogs after desktop file deletion
- **android**: Restore keyboard viewport after backgrounding
- **android**: Keep MediaPlayer audio in the platform mixer
- **ios**: Preserve NAS streaming format hints and native errors
- **link**: Delete shared phone songs from desktop
- **desktop**: Keep Material player bar controls inside narrow windows
- **files**: Align the reorganize flow with the app's UI rules
- **library**: Preserve artwork and silence automatic scan notices
- **windows**: Omit unused FFmpegKit native plugin
- **files**: Keep relocation compatible with system SQLite
- **windows**: Recognize alternate paths to the same library file (#789)
- **windows**: Treat verbatim and plain paths as the same file by [@kevenchantre](https://github.com/kevenchantre)
- **l10n**: Validate and merge Crowdin translations (#734)
- **download**: Resolve SAF conversion filenames from document metadata (#768)
- **storage**: Allow cancellable large-file uploads (#762) ([#762](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/pull/762))
- **storage**: Decouple upload timeouts for large file transfers by [@Rohitkr0406](https://github.com/Rohitkr0406)
- **playback**: Support gapless exclusive output and guard metadata lifecycle
- **android**: Size notification mark for the status bar
- **android**: Promote download service before queue preparation
- **lyrics**: Reduce translation latency and recover missing lines
- **link**: Preserve artwork during remote track changes
- **player**: Center immersive Material landscape content
- **link**: Relay playback artwork and metadata across devices
- **equalizer**: Preserve signed zero in control selectors
- **audio**: Reconcile USB output status with native playback
- **lyrics**: Complete Material word lift before stopping the clock

- **link**: Read embedded phone lyrics without cached audio

### Performance

- **backend**: Migrate selected data jobs to Rust
- **link**: Reuse desktop player window state
- **link**: Filter remote rows and release published phone catalogs
- **library**: Share Android thumbnail files by content
- **equalizer**: Isolate control rebuilds and defer serialization

- **covers**: Memoize reference keys and offload index warmup
- **images**: Bound landscape artwork and extension icon decodes
- **link**: Suppress idle state heartbeats and redundant pings
- **player**: Bound Android session queue messages
- **shell**: Defer idle preload and freeze hidden tab size
- **library**: Measure uniform desktop song row extents
- **rewind**: Cache backdrop blur and cap story updates
- **library**: Reduce schema writes and repeated path migration
- **library**: Restrict filtered album aggregates
- **library**: Reuse suggestion matching and playlist seeds
- **home**: Share counts and reuse unchanged shelves
- **network**: Keep one Subsonic metadata client per connection
- **shell**: Keep the Store update count out of MainShell

- **player**: Set the AutoMix start timer again only when the start moves

- **network**: Keep NAS tag covers the cache already holds
- **covers**: Link identical Library thumbnails on desktop and iOS
- **covers**: Flush scan thumbnails once per scan on Apple
- **ui**: Lazily build large logs and review lists
- **library**: Batch retained-page refreshes

### Refactoring

- Reorganize and streamline file settings and download queue logic by [@kevenchantre](https://github.com/kevenchantre)

### Testing

- **search**: Note why the Mornye fingerprints changed
- **network**: Accept the file type in streaming routes
- Fix native cache cleanup fixtures (#786) ([#786](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/pull/786))
- Pass empty cover references to native cleanup by [@frpboy](https://github.com/frpboy)

### Chores

Android APKs: **5.3.1-hotfix.2 (build 168)**. Restricts the Glyph mixer workaround to Nothing devices to address reported volume control issues on other phones.

apps.name: SceneBox
apps.subtitle: Torrent streaming client
apps.localizedDescription:
Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.
